# Detection coverage (generated)

<!-- Generated by `python -m agentwall.src.bench --format markdown`; do not edit by hand. A test fails if this file differs from a fresh run. -->

Corpus `b278af0b89cd00aa`: 492 labelled samples written by the RedHand team, in English and Bahasa Malaysia. Detectors measured: `egress_guardrail`, `radar`, `manifest_auditor`, `description_auditor`.

**How to read this.** The corpus is small and written by us, so these numbers flatter the detectors: real attackers rephrase, and variants of one idea are correlated (see the families column). The 95% intervals show how uncertain a rate is at this size. Nothing here means RedHand blocks 100% of anything, and RedHand only checks what flows through its gateway.

Status rules (fixed in advance): **covered** = detection >= 90% and false alarms <= 1%; **partial** = >= 50% and <= 5%; **weak** = detects something but misses the partial bar; **not covered** = detects nothing. A category with fewer than 20 samples on either side is **insufficient data**.

## Held-out results (never tuned on: quote these)

Held-out samples are not used to write or tune rules (a change made after seeing them is disclosed where it happens). A held-out set written by the same author as the rules is less independent than one written by someone else, and 20 samples can only prove so much: read the confidence interval, not the point estimate. A category with a held-out set is rated on it; the dev table above is what the rules were written against.

| Category | OWASP | Malicious | Benign | Detection (95% CI) | False alarms (95% CI) | Hard benign false alarms | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `injection_indirect` | LLM01 | 20 | 20 | 17/20 = 85% (64%-95%) | 0/20 (at most 16% with 95% confidence) | 0/10 | **partial** |
| `output_path` | LLM05 | 20 | 20 | 19/20 = 95% (76%-99%) | 0/20 (at most 16% with 95% confidence) | 0/10 | **covered** |
| `output_ssrf` | LLM05 | 20 | 20 | 20/20 (at least 84% with 95% confidence) | 0/20 (at most 16% with 95% confidence) | 0/10 | **covered** |
| `output_xss` | LLM05 | 20 | 20 | 20/20 (at least 84% with 95% confidence) | 0/20 (at most 16% with 95% confidence) | 0/10 | **covered** |
| `tool_poisoning` | LLM01 | 20 | 20 | 13/20 = 65% (43%-82%) | 0/20 (at most 16% with 95% confidence) | 0/12 | **partial** |

Status is assigned from point estimates, by rules fixed in M1. With 20 benign samples the false alarm rate is only known to be below about 16%, so read **covered** here as "no misses found yet", not as a guarantee. The corpus grows with independently written samples (plan `docs/plans/phase4-m4-plan.md`, section 11.3) and the status rule moves to the upper confidence bound at M4.6.
